consent.title: Microphone for the AI tutor
consent.body: Your child can talk out loud with the AI tutor instead of typing. Their voice is sent to our speech provider so it can be turned into text, and it is never stored by us. The tutor's replies and the written conversation are saved for 90 days so you and your child can read or replay them. You can turn this off at any time.
